h: Lightwoods Park, just up the road
p: Bearwood Road is the busy high street of Bearwood, the part of Smethwick that sits right on the Birmingham border. This Admiral is one of a few adult gaming centres along it, and like the rest it's 18+ only.

If you want a break from the traffic, Lightwoods Park is a few minutes' walk away. It's a proper green space with a restored Georgian house at its heart, Lightwoods House, plus a café and walled garden that make a nice spot to sit with a brew. Bearwood bus station is close by too, so it's easy to hop on a bus into Birmingham city centre or out across the Black Country if you're carrying on elsewhere.
